description: This file defines an immutable, read-only collection class 'RingRangeCollection' that manages non-overlapping, sorted ranges represented by 'RingRange' objects. It provides methods for creation, containment checks, intersection detection, difference calculation, and enumeration of ranges, primarily supporting operations relevant to ring or circular range management within the Orleans runtime.

classes.name: RingRangeCollection
classes.description: An immutable, sorted collection of non-overlapping 'RingRange' objects managing ranges within a circular range space.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new 'RingRangeCollection' from any collection of 'RingRange' objects, filtering out empty ranges and sorting by start position.

methods.name: Difference
methods.description: Calculates the difference between this collection and a previous one, returning ranges in this collection not covered by the previous.
